title: erigeron filifolius
intro: Erigeron filifolius, commonly known as a type of daisy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders. The health benefits of Erigeron filifolius include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce swelling and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing fever, relieving pain, and promoting relaxation.
